title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Meow Apps AI…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Meow Apps AI Engine (ai-engine) versions up to 3.9.3. This vulnerability arises from improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing attackers to inject malicious scripts that can execute in users' browsers. The flaw affects confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected system.
